title: schiedeella tenella
intro: Schiedeella tenella, commonly known as the "Mexican feathergrass," is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from infections. The bioactive constituents of Schiedeella tenella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
